review:
Ancient Egypt as a cartoon: a charming mummy runs a colourful tomb on shifting Megaways reels, with cascades after every win.

When the bonus starts, the mummy wakes up and summons boosters whose multipliers multiply each other instead of adding up – which is how things can get big very quickly. Chance x2 doubles your free spins odds. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP. Free spins about once every 282 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
